title: Introduce ephemeral prefetch fuse and backpressure granulator to reduce micro-burst SLO violations
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: We observed recurring small-duration micro-bursts that push tail latency over SLOs in certain regional pools. Root cause analysis points to simultaneous admission of short requests that defeat batching heuristics and cause KV pressure spikes that trigger circuit state churn. This PR introduces two cooperating runtime mechanisms: (1) an ephemeral prefetch fuse that temporally coalesces closely arriving short requests for the same tenant/route to enable efficient micro-batches without increasing steady-state latency, and (2) a backpressure granulator that slices tenant admission capacity into short, smoothly-distributed tokens (rate-sipping) to prevent burst demolition of soft SLO budgets. Both features are opt-in per-route and default-off; the implementation includes conservative telemetry, toggles, and an automated safety gate that disables the fuse if tail latency or error-rate regressions are detected. Changes include: new admission/fuse state machine, granular token bucket allocator, additional metrics and tracing, a canary rollout strategy and a short hotfix to handle an observed race on KV cache eviction. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3482) - [x] Unit + integration tests for fuse state transitions - [x] Added telemetry: per-tenant micro-batch ratio, token-sip-utilization, fuse-failures - [x] Canary config and automated rollback thresholds - [x] Per-route opt-in config and api surface for Redwood Console Risk: medium; introduces new admission path and state machine. Mitigations: opt-in by default, staged canary, realtime safety gate, extended test harness load runs in CI. See design notes: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3482/ephemeral-prefetch-and-backpressure-granulator

diff_overview: prefetch_fuse.go: new state machine (Idle -> Sampling -> FuseOpen -> FuseDrain) with time-window coalescing logic
backpressure_granulator.go: token-sip allocator that slices tenant token budgets into small intervals to smooth micro-bursts
eviction_hotfix.go: small synchronization fix to prevent concurrent eviction+read races seen in canary

release_notes: Add opt-in ephemeral prefetch fuse and backpressure granulator to smooth micro-bursts and reduce tail latency SLO violations. Default-off; consult Console feature toggles for rollout. Includes KV eviction race hotfix.
notes_for_ops: Enable per-route prefatch fuse via Console in canary region first (region-us-west-2). Watch metrics: telemetry.micro_batch_ratio, telemetry.token_sip_utilization, telemetry.fuse_disable_reasons, slo.tail_p99. If safety gate triggers, fuse will auto-disable and ops will be alerted. Recommended canary window: 3 hours with progressive ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
post_merge_actions: Provision canary in us-west-2 and enable that route on 5 tenants
Run 30min micro-burst load harness against canary; verify tail-p99 improvement and stable kv_eviction_race metric
If safe, ramp using Console toggle over 24 hours
